final_decision.mode: CI-statistical fingerprint (PSNR invalid: noise seed mismatch; wavelet sigma estimator invalid for sparse impulse)
final_decision.rationale: Single support pair. 90.00% of residual pixels are exactly zero and the remaining ~10% are exact 0/255 (salt&pepper, ~5%/5%) -> noise_impulse amount=0.10 = severity 5. Two independent seeds reproduce all 10 content-independent metrics within 0.013%; sev4 (amount 0.07) misfits impulse metrics by 30%. No other degradation can be present because all non-impulse pixels are byte-identical to clean. Global contrast/saturation detections are outlier-inflation false positives of the sparse 0/255 pixels. Verdict capped at UNCERTAIN per noise rules (noise type/severity never LIKELY due to seed mismatch).
